Final Budget Outcome

Purpose

The Final Budget Outcome (FBO) provides the final fiscal outcomes for the preceding financial year and is based on external reporting standards.

The financial statements in the FBO are similar to those in the Budget but provide actual outcomes rather than estimates

Timing

The Charter of Budget Honesty Act 1998 requires that a Final Budget Outcome be released no later than 3 months after the end of the relevant financial year.

2024–25 Final Budget Outcome

The Final Budget Outcome for the 2024–25 financial year was released on Monday 29 September 2025.

Visit the Budget archive to view and download the FBO documents
